item.description: - Added clickable status cards to filter libraries by Healthy, Needs Attention, Offline, or Total. - Added multi-selection and batch removal for library records, with confirmation and classic-order preservation. - Added direct library actions to Diagnostics, including showing the folder, repairing, relocating, and removing records. - Improved batch-removal recovery so the inventory stays synchronized after partial platform failures. - Preserved native language names in the language selector, including English, Español, Português (Brasil), and 简体中文.
